objective: Replace SG039's known 60-observation Fourier diagnosis with period search, distinguishing actual oscillation from colored-noise false peaks; report abstention and error tradeoffs.
algorithm: SG038 primary/secondary estimators, SG039 candidate challenge and SG037 predecision risk gate unchanged. Detrend last min(n,160) observations. Search Fourier powers at integer candidate periods 25,30,...,100. Let highest normalized power P and highest peak >=20 periods away Q. Diagnose oscillation only when P>=0.45 and P>=1.4Q. On disagreement trust primary only when diagnostic passes; otherwise abstain at alarmed final decision or continue early acquisition.

pilot.disclosure: Pilot informed threshold. 0.35 had one extra false rejection, 0.45 avoided it in pilot; not an untouched test.

negative_controls: Colored control rho=.94 starting at continuation time 0
limits: Spectral search on same observation stream not independent witness
Known candidate frequency range selected from synthetic context, not general arbitrary frequencies
Periodicity of colored noise may generate spurious peaks and raise false diagnosis
Experiment evaluates synthetic data only, not formal coverage guarantee
